models.S1_placement_coverage: Pieces placement x c/n when c<n (missing Reference slots score 0)
models.Q_short0.5_excessX: S0 total x (1 - 0.5*worstShortRatio - X*min(1,worstExcessRatio)), X in {0,0.15,0.25}
models.S4_star_cap_bands: S0 total capped by worst kept ratio: <1 ->89.9, <2/3 ->74.9, <1/2 ->59.9

rule.deadline: serve k at k*T counts iff k*T < 180 s (src/mission/lunchRush.ts isMissionExpired: now >= endsAt)
rule.secondsPerPizza: 25.0 + perItem * items (items = pieces + spreads); MODEL, not measured
rule.qualityModel: under-fill quality = max(0, S0 * (1 - a * worstShortRatio)); ideal = S0
rule.runScore: Math.round(servedCount * 100 + sum(quality)) (src/logic/missionScoring.ts missionScore, src/shared/lunchRushScoring.ts calculateLunchRushMissionScore); halves round up. Break-even compares these integers: an under-fill run beats ideal iff its unrounded score >= ideal + 1/2, so a coefficient strictly above the reported boundary deters it. The order stream averages per-run rounded scores (it never rounds the average)
rule.orderStream: 2000 runs, random.Random(seed=215*100003+run), pool = all 15 recipes, uniform pick avoiding the previous recipe (orders.ts getNextOrder/avoidRepeat); same order sequence for every plan; a pizza that would finish at or after 180 s never scores

lunchRushDiscrete.note: Rev.3 replaces the Rev.2 points-per-second model, which awarded fractional serves. Rev.5 applies production's final Math.round to every run score before comparing. `a` multiplies the worst shortage ratio. MODEL ONLY: per-item seconds are assumptions.

lunchRushModel.runScoreRounding: lrPointsPerRunModel = Math.round(completed serves * points per serve)
lunchRushModel.servesCounted: completed serves only, strictly before 180 s (see lunchRushDiscrete.rule)
lunchRushModel.caveat: MODEL ONLY -- not measured; real per-piece time is higher on a phone (drag+drop).
